claims.note: Title and description restate two published cells: temporal-expression preservation 3.05% to 62.39% (arXiv 2608.11775 Table 3) and retrieval 21.0 to 63.9 with completion flat (arXiv 2608.16370). Both were matched to the papers' own text; neither is presented as a first-party result.

clear_tool_uses_20250919 is quoted as 'automatically clears the oldest tool results in chronological order' with placeholder substitution, matched verbatim in the live docs; the following sentence is the reviewer-visible inference that age is not relevance, and it is framed as such.

Cache-invalidation sentence matches prompt-caching word for word; the survival table matches context-window ('Project-root CLAUDE.md ... Re-injected from disk', 're-reads up to five, most recently modified first', 'capped at 5,000 tokens per skill and 25,000 tokens total; oldest dropped first'), and the article limits the table to that one harness.

80% to 85% at paired p = 1.0 with a CI containing zero, retrieval 21.0 to 63.9 at p = .002, retrieval rising in all six model-regime comparisons, and completion significant only for DeepSeek at 10x all appear in arXiv 2608.16370; ALFWorld is cited for the environment-dependence caveat the paper itself states.

Denominators re-verified on the arXiv 2608.11775 PDF for round 2: 1,935 matched text-only questions across ten conversations, 1,501 in the primary categories-1-4 aggregate after Category 5 (adversarial) exclusion, Table 3 preservation over 952 temporal expressions (3.05% to 62.39%, x1.02 named entity, x1.11 event), and +0.314 [0.254, 0.375] with n = 315 for the paired category-2 delta.

The article states the improved arm is 'identical to SWC-Full except for one added sentence at the prompt start', which is the paper's own condition description; the round-1 unmeasured cost clause is gone, so no claim is made about the summariser's size or cost.

Primacy/recency sentence is the Lost in the Middle abstract verbatim; the Chroma panel is cited only for length-sensitivity across 18 LLMs, and its vendor-research status is carried in the article's Limits section.

A requirement of the measurement design, not a measured value: the control arm exists so that model recall over a full transcript is separated from compaction loss, mirroring the reacquisition study's uncompressed baseline.
The 95 percent retention and 60 percent reduction thresholds are falsification rules the article states for a reader's own run; they are not measurements and are attributed to no source.
Protocol step: five 8,000-12,000-token transcripts with 12 seeded facts and six distractors. This describes the shipped template's shape and makes no retention claim.

Reader-facing artifacts in research/evidence/agent-context-compaction-fidelity-2026/ were opened in this run: template, scorer, fixture test, fixture data and captured output hash to the receipt's public_artifacts, and an independent re-run on Python 3.12.3 produced the same six passing tests. The article says explicitly that the fixture tests the scoring rules, not a model.
